IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, sleek brown
hair pulled back holds a patterned mug while
seated cross-legged on a sage floral sofa. She
wears a lavender ribbed turtleneck, layered silver
chains, and gold hoop earrings. Her patterned
purple-and-brown knit trousers and chunky pale
sneakers complete the look. Soft morning light from
a sheer curtain. Palette of lilac, sage, and warm
gold. Cozy and nostalgic, in the style of a 1990s
film still.
